name: DaYan Void Cube (Limited Edition)
description: The Dayan Void Cube is a throwback to one of the most iconic 3x3 variations ever made. With no center pieces, it adds a fun twist to the classic puzzle and feels like a piece of cubing history. These are older versions that aren’t made anymore, packaged in Calvin’s Puzzle boxes. Great for collectors or anyone who remembers the early days of modern cubing. Very limited stock.
